## Bundled filter lists

`src-tauri/blocklist/rules.jsonl.br` is compiled from the filter lists below and
embedded in the Foxlite binary as a data resource. The compiled rule set is a
derivative work of those lists and stays subject to their licenses — the Apache
License covers the converter (`tools/blocklist/build.mjs`), not the rules it
produces.

Generated 2026-08-20 · 183,584 rules.

| List | Category | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| EasyList | ads | CC BY-SA 3.0 / GPLv3 | [easylist.to](https://easylist.to/easylist/easylist.txt) |
| EasyPrivacy | privacy | CC BY-SA 3.0 / GPLv3 | [easylist.to](https://easylist.to/easylist/easyprivacy.txt) |
| Peter Lowe's list | privacy | McRae General Public License | [pgl.yoyo.org](https://pgl.yoyo.org/adservers/) |
| NoCoin | privacy | MIT | [github.com](https://github.com/hoshsadiq/adblock-nocoin-list) |
| URLhaus malware hosts | security | CC0 | [urlhaus.abuse.ch](https://urlhaus.abuse.ch/downloads/hostfile/) |
| Malicious URL Blocklist (URLhaus) | security | CC0 | [malware-filter.gitlab.io](https://malware-filter.gitlab.io/malware-filter/urlhaus-filter.txt) |
| Phishing URL Blocklist (OpenPhish/PhishTank) | security | CC0 | [malware-filter.gitlab.io](https://malware-filter.gitlab.io/malware-filter/phishing-filter.txt) |
| EasyList Cookie List | annoyances | CC BY-SA 3.0 / GPLv3 | [secure.fanboy.co.nz](https://secure.fanboy.co.nz/fanboy-cookiemonster.txt) |

EasyList, EasyPrivacy and the EasyList Cookie List are dual-licensed under
CC BY-SA 3.0 **or** GPLv3. Foxlite takes the CC BY-SA 3.0 option and satisfies
it with the attribution in this table; the rules travel as data inside the
application, not as part of its code.

uBlock Origin's own filter lists (GPLv3) are **not** in the shipped blocklist.
`npm run blocklist:ubo` adds them for local builds only — a build made that way
should not be redistributed under these notices.

## Dependencies

Foxlite's Rust and JavaScript dependencies are permissively licensed
(MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD-3-Clause). The authoritative list is
`src-tauri/Cargo.lock` and `package-lock.json`; run `cargo license` in
`src-tauri/` for a current per-crate breakdown.

The browser engine is the operating system's own WebView (WKWebView on macOS)
and is not redistributed with Foxlite.
